# Summary
:::

Research engineer with 5+ years turning R&D problems into production software in pharma, cosmetics, and biotech. Maintain 20+ R Shiny applications used daily by researchers, plus statistical modelling (design of experiments, mixed models, multi-omics) and GxP-qualifiable delivery with tests, CI/CD and containers. Build LLM agents and MCP servers that put typed statistical tools in a model's hands.
:::
